title: Phyrexia: The Strong and the Scattered

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The invading necromechanical power, now diversified into five color-aligned factions on Mirrodin.

entities.name: The Mirrans
entities.description: The heterogeneous population of Mirrodin, now unified against Phyrexia.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: The metal plane under Phyrexian invasion, whose planar core harbors the corruption.

entities.name: Koth of the Hammer
entities.description: A planeswalker from Mirrodin who sought other-planar help against the spreading Mephidross.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A planeswalker whose childhood home plane was ravaged by Phyrexia, leaving lasting psychic wounds.

entities.name: Venser
entities.description: A planeswalker who grew up in Urborg and was once mentored by Karn.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: The silver golem and Mirrodin's creator, imprisoned in the Phyrexia-controlled core and torn between rage and embracing his throne as the new Father of Machines.

entities.name: Glissa Sunseeker
entities.description: An elf hero of the original Mirrodin block, once the finest hunter in the Tangle, falsely blamed by the elves and later compleated by Vorinclex.

entities.name: Vorinclex
entities.description: The Phyrexian Praetor of the green-aligned faction, who compleated Glissa.

entities.name: Sheoldred
entities.description: A Phyrexian Praetor serving as one of the major generals on the Phyrexian side.

entities.name: The Praetors
entities.description: The five cunning rulers who each lead one of the Phyrexian factions on Mirrodin.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: The one-time guardian of Mirrodin who tried to use Glissa to gain a planeswalker spark.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A planeswalker fascinated by Phyrexia and Mirrodin who plays both sides as the eyes and ears of another.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: The ruler under whom Phyrexia was once a monolithic threat.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Leader whose planeswalker allies devastated the plane of Phyrexia during the invasion of Dominaria.

entities.name: The Tangle
entities.description: The Mirrodin forest home of the elves, attacked by Memnarch.

entities.name: The Mephidross
entities.description: A region of Mirrodin whose corruption began spreading beyond its borders.

events.summary: Koth, Elspeth and Venser try to track the Phyrexian corruption to its source, but it is far too late.
events.quote: And all three of them believed they could track the Phyrexian corruption to its source

events.summary: The Mirrans realize the full breadth of the threat and unite under a single banner.
events.quote: The struggle has caused Mirrodin's heterogeneous population to fly a single banner.

events.summary: Phyrexia, devastated by Urza's allies, endures through its oil and evolves along all five colors on Mirrodin, splitting into five factions led by Praetors.
events.quote: What was once a monolithic threat united under Yawgmoth is now five distinct subfactions.

events.summary: Glissa thwarts Memnarch's plans, then disappears; the elves blame her for misfortunes and call her Glissa the Traitor.
events.quote: They called her Glissa the Traitor, and the name stuck.

events.summary: Glissa retreats into Mirrodin's core where small constructs carry her down and keep her unconscious.
events.quote: The machines kept her safe and sound—but unconscious.

events.summary: The Praetor Vorinclex compleates the corrupted Glissa and unleashes her as a Phyrexian ally for the siege.
events.quote: The Praetor Vorinclex compleated the former elf hero

events.summary: Karn, imprisoned in the core, vacillates between raging against captivity and embracing his throne as the new Father of Machines.
events.quote: sometimes embracing his throne (as it, indeed, has embraced him) and acting as the new Father of Machines

relations.quote: The Praetor Vorinclex compleated the former elf hero

relations.note: Compleated by Vorinclex and now an arm of the green Phyrexian faction.
relations.quote: She has become a powerful arm of Phyrexia's green-aligned faction

relations.note: Memnarch targeted Glissa, who thwarted him.
relations.quote: Glissa managed to thwart Memnarch's plans at the end of the Mirrodin block
